title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 1.00 (quiet) at 13:00 UTC on 8 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 8 日 13:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 1.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 1.00 (1Z) at 13:00 UTC on 8 October 2026. The 13 hour is complete (60 samples through 13:59; hour-start 1.00/1Z, hour-end 1.33/1P). Last-180 maximum is 2.00 (first at 2026-10-08T11:59:00Z; label 2Z). Published-window maximum is 2.33 (first at 2026-10-08T11:41:00Z; label 2P). Window starts 2026-10-08T09:01:00Z (358 samples). Window estimated_kp reached 2.33. The 14 UTC hour on 8 October is incomplete (59 samples through 14:58).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
